wins: Consistently captured SSH and HTTP banners early (ep001_step02, ep001_step04), enabling precise target profiling and high reward despite failure.
Maintained mentor engagement cadence, collecting detailed environment feedback that can guide the next experiment.
fails: Privilege escalation attempts stalled due to missing credentials and absence of writable sudoers entries (ep001_step12).
Failed to pivot from initial host to internal network segments because lateral movement tools were not executed after initial enumeration (ep001_step15).
key_outcomes.summary: Run delivered strong early reconnaissance data but could not translate that into foothold or lateral movement, resulting in zero successful episode completions.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Repeated privilege escalation commands (sudo -l, exploit scripts) failed because the target lacked sudo rights and stored credentials were invalid.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with targeted nmap scripts and ssh-audit

skill_cards.if_condition: If HTTP 80/443 responds with banner indicating outdated server
skill_cards.then_action: Trigger nikto scan followed by directory brute force for common paths

skill_cards.if_condition: Upon receipt of filesystem info showing writable /tmp
skill_cards.then_action: Deploy limited local enumeration with linpeas and grep for sudo permissions

memory_ops.reason: High success capturing SSH metadata critical for future targeting.
Effective HTTP banner enumeration provided actionable intelligence within first 5 steps.

next_experiments.title: Credential gathering before privilege escalation
next_experiments.description: Focus on harvesting valid credentials via HTTP forms or SSH fallback before attempting sudo enumeration to avoid repeated denial.

next_experiments.title: Automated pivot trigger post enumeration
next_experiments.description: After successful service enumeration, trigger lateral movement scripts targeting adjacent subnet hosts to validate pivot capability.
